Sympathy|publisher=Sherdog.com|accessdate=2012-09-05}}\n\n===Background===\n\nThe original main event of [[Jan B\u0142achowicz]] fighting [[Dave Branch (fighter)|Dave Branch]] was changed when Branch had passport issues in the days leading up to the event.{{cite web |url=http://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Le-Banner-Injured-Valentijn-Overeem-Meets-Marcin-Rozalski-in-New-KSW-18-Headliner-40513 |title=Le Banner injured; Valentijn Overeem meets Marcin Rozalski in new KSW 18 headliner |first=Mike |last=Whitman |date=February 22, 2012 |accessdate=April 1, 2012}} He was replaced by Mario Miranda. \n\nMarcin R\u00f3\u017calski was initially scheduled to face [[Jerome Le Banner]] in a non-main event fight. However, a knee injury forced Le Banner off the card and with only two days notice [[Valentijn Overeem]] stepped in as a replacement.{{cite web |url=http://prommanow.com/index.php/2012/02/26/overeem-submits-rozalski-in-ksw-18-main-event-full-results-and-video/ |title=Overeem submits R\u00f3\u017calski in KSW 18 main event; full results and the Giants|publisher=Sherdog.com |accessdate=2013-08-01}}\n\n===Background===\n\nThe main event saw [[Mariusz Pudzianowski]] against [[Sean McCorkle]] in a rematch.\n\nThe event also crowned the first heavyweight champion in a match between [[Pawel Nastula]] and Karol Bedorf. The event also featured a rematch between [[Micha\u0142 Materla]] and [[Jay Silva]] in the middleweight division. [[Mateusz Gamrot]] replaced current lightweight champion [[Maciej Jewtuszko]] as [[Ultimate Fighting Championship|UFC]] veteran [[Andre Winner]]'s opponent.{{cite web|url=http://www.adcombat.com/pudzianowski-vs-mccorkle-2-confirmed-for-ksw-24|title=Pudzianowski vs. McCorkle 2 confirmed for KSW Future events in this year will appear on PPV in Poland and the web platform KSW TV worldwide.{{Cite web|url=http://www.konfrontacja.com/en/index.php?s=news&newsID=2080&wyniki-oficjalnego-przed-ksw-34|title=KSW - Martial Arts Confrontation - Official KSW Federation website|last=ksw|website=www.konfrontacja.com|access-date=2016-03-29|archive-date=2016-04-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160422224523/http://www.konfrontacja.com/en/index.php?s=news&newsID=2080&wyniki-oficjalnego-przed-ksw-34|url-status=dead}}\n\nOwners of Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki announced that [[Tomasz Narkun]] was expected to face Andre Muniz in his first title defense. On February 25, it was announced that Muniz withdrew from the bout due to elbow injury and was replaced by Cassio Barbosa de Oliveira who defeated [[Ultimate Fighting Championship|UFC]] veteran [[Ronny Markes]] two weeks earlier at Shooto Brazil 61.\n\n\u0141ukasz Bie\u0144kowski was expected to face Svetlozar Savov,{{Cite web|url=http://www.konfrontacja.com/en/index.php?s=news&newsID=2058&svetlozar-savov-podpisa%25B3-kontrakt-z-ksw-powalczy-z-bie%25F1kowskim-na-ksw-34|title=KSW - Martial Arts Confrontation - Official KSW Federation website|last=ksw|website=www.konfrontacja.com|access-date=2016-03-29|archive-date=2016-04-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160422172925/http://www.konfrontacja.com/en/index.php?s=news&newsID=2058&svetlozar-savov-podpisa%25B3-kontrakt-z-ksw-powalczy-z-bie%25F1kowskim-na-ksw-34|url-status=dead}} but on March 1, it was announced that Bie\u0144kowski pulled out due to injury and Antoni Chmielewski (who was planning to take part in PLMMA 64 on March 18, 2016) was added as a 'last minute' replacement.\n\nOne of the scheduled opening fights on the card was a match-up between Grzegorz Szulakowski and Bart\u0142omiej Kurczewski. Szulakowski had to pull out due to an arm injury and there was no replacement for him, so the bout was deleted from the card.{{Cite web|url=http://www.mmarocks.pl/featured/szulakowski-i-bienkowski-wypadaja-z-ksw-34-wraca-antoni-chmielewski|title=Szulakowski i Bie\u0144kowski wypadaj\u0105 z KSW 34, wraca Antoni Chmielewski {{!}} [[Ergo Arena]] in [[Gda\u0144sk]] / [[Sopot|Sopot, Poland]]\n\n===Background===\n\nThe event was initially planned for May 28 but was rescheduled due to a conflict with Polsat's music show Polsat SuperHit Festival 2016 .\n\nThis event appeared on PPV (after two opening fights) in Poland and KSW TV worldwide. The Polish organization announced that KSW 35 will be the first event broadcast in [[Virtual reality|VR]] 360\u00b0 technology which will be an innovation broadcasting MMA events.\n\nFormer [[Ultimate Fighting Championship|UFC]] fighter and [[The Ultimate Fighter|TUF]] competitor Marcin Wrzosek was expected to face Anzor Azhiev in featherweight title eliminator, but April 1, 2016 KSW announced that Azhiev is injured and Filip Wola\u0144ski will replace him.{{Cite web|url=https://twitter.com/KSW_MMA/status/715798529063665665|title=KSW on Twitter|website=Twitter|access-date=2016-04-01}}\n\nLukasz Chlewick was expected to fight Marif Piraev, however Piraev was pulled out on May 23. 40: Dublin|KSW 40]]\n}}\n\n'''KSW 39: Colosseum''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki on May 27, 2017, at the [[National Stadium, Warsaw|PGE Narodowy]] in [[Warsaw]], [[Poland]].\n\n=== Background ===\nFormer KSW Heavyweight Champion, Karol Bedorf, tore his Achilles' tendon and was unable to fight Michal Kita. He was replaced by [[Micha\u0142 Andryszak]].\n\nKSW 39 became the 2nd highest MMA attendance record with 57,776, behind only the [[2002 in Pride FC#Pride FC: Shockwave|Pride FC: Shockwave]] event from 2002. It also beat [[UFC 193]] attendance.\n\n==== Bonus awards ====\n\nThe following fighters were awarded bonuses:\n* Fight of the Night: [[Mamed Khalidov]] vs. Borys Ma\u0144kowski\n* Knockout of the Night: Marcin Rozalski\n* Submission of the Night: [[Micha\u0142 Andryszak]]\n\n=== Results ===\n{| class=\"wikitable\" style=\"font-size: 80%;\"\n|-\n! Debutant Pawe\u0142 Polity\u0142o faced Antun Ra\u010di\u0107.\n\n[[Norman Parke]] missed his weight, at 70.8 kg. The fight between Parke and Gamrot was therefore a non-title fight. Parke was fined 30% of his purse for missing weight.\n\n[[James McSweeney]] was not permitted to fight after he was not cleared by Safe MMA Ireland. [[Jay Silva]] stepped in as a replacement against [[Mariusz Pudzianowski]] in the main event.\n\n==== Bonus awards ====\n\nThe following fighters were awarded bonuses:\n* Fight of the Night: [[David Background ===\nThe original co-main event featured the rematch between Marcin Wrzosek and [[Kleber Koike Erbst]] for the vacant featherweight title. However Wrzosek suffered a pectoral muscle tear and was forced out of the rematch. As a result, Marian Ziolkowski stepped in against Erbst in a catchweight fight.\n\n'''Bonus awards'''\n\nThe following fighters were awarded bonuses:\n* '''Fight of the Night:''' Daniel Torres vs. Sztuk Walki on October 6, 2018, at the [[Wembley Arena]] in [[London]], [[England]].\n\n=== Background ===\n[[Micha\u0142 Andryszak]] got injured, [[Thiago Silva (fighter)|Thiago Silva]] steps in on short notice to replace Andryszak against [[James McSweeney]].\n\nJohn Smith withdrew from his bout with Akop Szostak. Akop Szostak (3-2) will now face Jamie Sloane, who step in on less than two weeks\u2019 notice.\n\nMax Nunes no-showed KSW's fight week obligations, Lukasz Parobiec steps up on two days' notice to face [[Wagner Prado]].\n\nAkop Szostak vs. Jamie Sloane ruled a no-contest following an accidental eye poke in the first round.\n\n'''Bonus awards'''\n\nThe following fighters will be awarded bonuses:\n* '''Fight of the Night:''' [[Roberto Soldi\u0107]] vs. [[Dricus du Plessis]]\n* '''Knockout of the Night:''' Wagner Prado and [[Scott Askham]]\n* '''Submission of the Night:''' [[Phil De face Zi\u00f3\u0142kowski.\n\n'''Bonus awards'''\n\nThe following fighters will be awarded bonuses:\n* '''Fight of the Night:''' [[Tomasz Narkun]] vs. [[Mamed Khalidov]] and Romaz Szymanski vs. Daniel X-Warriors'''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki on March 23, 2019 at the [[Atlas Arena]] in [[\u0141\u00f3d\u017a]], [[Poland]].\n\n=== Background ===\nThe event was headlined by a KSW Heavyweight Championship bout between the champion Phil De Fries and KSW Light Heavyweight Champion Tomasz Narkun.{{cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.com/2019/01/ksw-47-gets-champ-vs-champ-headliner-with-phil-de-fries-vs-tomasz-narkun|title=KSW 47 gets champ vs. champ headliner with Phil De Fries vs. Tomasz Narkun|author=Staff|publisher=mmajunkie.com|date=2019-01-23|access-date=2019-05-05}}\n\nA heavyweight superfight between the five-time World's Strongest Man Mariusz Pudzianowski and Olympic weightlifting gold medalist Szymon Kolecki took place as the co-main event.{{cite news|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2018/12/1/18121244/mariusz-pudzianowski-meets-olympic-gold-medalist-szymon-kolecki-in-ksw-47-main-event|title=Mariusz Pudzianowski meets Olympic gold medalist Szymon Kolecki in KSW 47 main event |publisher=mmafighting.com}}\n\nDricus du Plessis was scheduled to fight against fellow former welterweight champion Borys Mankowski at KSW 47.{{cite news|url=https://www.sport24.co.za/OtherSport/South-Africa/dricus-du-plessis-to-face-polish-star-at-ksw-47-20181217|title=Dricus du Plessis to face Polish star at KSW 47|publisher=sport24.co}} However, du Plessis was forced off the card due to a weight issue.{{cite news|url=https://thebodylockmma.com/ksw/ksws-du-plessis-not-injured-moving-up-to-middleweight-on-doctors-orders/|title=KSW's Du Plessis not injured; moving up to middleweight on doctors\u2019 orders|publisher=thebodylockmma.com}} Norman Parke has stepped in on short notice for du Plessis to fight former welterweight champion.{{cite news|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2019/2/19/18231734/norman-parke-replaces-dricus-du-plessis-faces-borys-mankowski-at-ksw-47|title=Norman Parke replaces Dricus Du Plessis, faces Borys Mankowski at KSW 47|publisher=mmafighting.com}}\n\n'''Bonus awards'''\n\nThe following fighters were awarded bonuses:\n* '''Fight of the Night:''' Borys Ma\u0144kowski vs. [[Norman Parke]]\n* 2019\n|venue=[[Wembley Arena]]\n|city={{flagicon|ENG}} [[London]], [[England]]\n|attendance=\n|previousevent=\n|followingevent=\n}}\n''''''KSW 50: London'''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki on September 14, 2019 at the [[Wembley Arena]] in [[London]], [[England]].\n\n===Background===\nMarian Ziolkowski has been forced to withdraw from his scheduled interim [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Lightweight championship|KSW Lightweight Championship]] bout against [[Norman Parke]] due to knee injury. Parke instead faced the former [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Featherweight championship|KSW Featherweight Championshion]] Marcin Wrzosek, who stepped in on two weeks\u2019 notice for this encounter.{{cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2019/8/30/20840401/marcin-wrzosek-replaces-marian-ziolkowski-faces-norman-parke-for-interim-title-at-ksw-50|title=Marcin Wrzosek replaces Marian Ziolkowski, faces Norman Parke for interim title at KSW 50|publisher=mmafighting.com}}\n\nPhil De Fries was expected to defend his Heavyweight Championship against [[Damian Grabowski]] in the main event of the evening. However, Grabowski was forced off the card due to a hand injury. Luis Henrique has stepped in for the injured Grabowski to fight De Fries for the heavyweight title.{{cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2019/8/29/20838149/luis-henrique-replaces-damian-grabowski-faces-champion-philip-de-fries-at-ksw-50|title=Luis Henrique replaces Damian Grabowski, faces champion Philip De Fries at KSW 50|publisher=mmafighting.com}}\n\nPatrik Kincl has been forced to withdraw from his scheduled KSW Welterweight Championship bout against Roberto Soldi\u0107 due to a torn ligament in his arm. Soldi\u0107 instead faced Michal Pietrzak, who stepped in on four days\u2019 notice for this encounter. Instead of a welterweight title fight, the fight was 80 kg catchweight bout.{{cite Daniel Torres replaces Klaczek, he takes his place against Peji\u0107.{{cite news|url=https://www.croatiaweek.com/croatias-filip-pejic-now-faces-daniel-torres-at-ksw-51-in-zagreb/|title=Croatia's Filip Pejic now faces Daniel Torres at KSW 51 in Zagreb|publisher=croatiaweek.com}}\n\nDenis Stojni\u0107 has been forced to withdraw from his scheduled bout against Ante Delija due to an injury. Delija instead faced Oli Thompson, who stepped in on two days\u2019 notice for this encounter.{{cite news|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2019/11/ksw-51-oli-thompson-short-notice-call-for-croatia-debut|title=KSW 51: British heavyweight Oli Thompson gets short-notice call for KSW's Croatia debut|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com}}\n\nAleksandar Rakas was scheduled to face Krystian Kaszubowski on the main card, but Rakas had to withdraw from the fight when he suffered a foot injury due to a slip a day before the fight while walking his dog. [[Poland]]\n|}\n\n==Only One==\nThe series was officially announced by KSW and POLSAT TV at a press conference on December 7, 2019. The trainers for the series, which will feature 10 welterweight fighters, will be Marcin Wrzosek and \u0141ukasz Zaborowski. The 10 fighters will be competing for a contract with KSW. The weekly series will culminate in a live finale on POLSAT TV. It debuted on POLSAT TV on March 6, 2020.\n===Participants===\n* {{flagicon|POL}} Pawe\u0142 Kie\u0142ek \n* {{flagicon|POL}} Piotr Walawski\n* {{flagicon|POL}} Mariusz Radziszewski\n* |url=https://www.polsatsport.pl/wiadomosc/2019-12-07/ksw-53-znamy-date-i-pierwszych-bohaterow-powrot-pudzianowskiego/|title=KSW 53: Znamy dat\u0119 i pierwszych bohater\u00f3w! We do apologise for the inconvenience caused by this and we are thankful to the fans and to our athletes for your understanding of the situation. - KSW Federation.|date=March 11, 2020}}\n\n===Background===\n[[Norman Parke]] missed weight ahead of his trilogy bout with [[Mateusz Gamrot]] for the undisputed KSW Lightweight Title. Both parties have agreed to complete their trilogy, however, the bout was a five-round catchweight non-title bout.\n\nRoman Szyma\u0144ski was scheduled to face [[Mateusz Legierski]], but Legierski was forced off the card on June 25 with an injury. Filip Peji\u0107 served as Legierski's replacement, taking the short notice fight against Szyma\u0144ski.\n\n'''Bonus awards'''\n\nThe following fighters were awarded bonuses:\n* '''Fight of the [[Poland]]\n|attendance=\n|previousevent=\n|followingevent=\n}}\n''''''KSW 54: Gamrot vs. Zi\u00f3\u0142kowski'''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki on August 29, 2020 in [[Warsaw]], [[Poland]].\n\n===Background===\n[[Shamil Musaev (fighter)|Shamil Musaev]] was scheduled to challenge [[Mateusz Gamrot]] in the KSW 54 main event, but Musaev has to withdraw from the bout due to a knee injury sustained in training. Marian Zi\u00f3\u0142kowski was pulled from a planned bout with Maciej Kazieczko and faced Gamrot for the KSW Lightweight Championship in the KSW 54 main event. Kazieczko instead faced Karlo Caput who stepped in on short notice for this encounter.\n\n\u0141ukasz Rajewski missed weight by two pounds ahead of his scheduled lightweight bout with Bart\u0142omiej Kopera. Both parties have agreed to compete a catchweight bout, Rajewski has been fined 30 percent of his purse.\n\n'''Bonus awards'''\n\nThe following fighters were awarded bonuses:\n* '''Fight of the |url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/KSW-57-WeighIn-Results-Three-Title-Fights-Set-All-Fighters-on-Weight-176845|title=KSW 57 Weigh-In Results: Three Title Fights Set, All Fighters on Walki#KSW 57: De Fries vs. Kita|KSW 57: De Fries vs. Kita]]\n|followingevent=\n}}\n''''''KSW 58: Parnasse vs. Torres'''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki January 30, 2021 at the [[Toya (company)#Wytw\u00f3rnia Club|Wytw\u00f3rnia Club]] in [[\u0141\u00f3d\u017a]], [[Poland]].\n\n===Background===\nKSW 58 was headlined by a title fight between the [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Featherweight championship|KSW Featherweight champion]] [[Salahdine Parnasse]] and the challenger Daniel Torres. In the co-main event, a light heavyweight fight between the Olympic gold medalist [[Szymon Kolecki]] and the veteran Martin Zawada.{{cite web |last1=Martin |first1=Damon |title=Olympic gold medalist Szymon Kolecki headlines KSW 58 alongside featherweight title fight |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2020/12/19/22188293/olympic-gold-medalist-szymon-kolecki-headlines-ksw-58-alongside-featherweight-title-fight |website=mmafighting.com |date=19 December 2020 |access-date=27 December 2020}}\n\nThe card also featured a welterweight bout between Micha\u0142 Michalski and Mirko cro cop protege Aleksandar Rakas.{{cite web |url=https://www.polsatsport.pl/wiadomosc/2021-01-08/ksw-58-bartlomiej-kopera-kontra-francisco-barrio-dodane-do-karty-walk/?ref=series|title=KSW 58: Micha\u0142 Michalski kontra Aleksandar Rakas w karcie walk|date=8 January 2021 |publisher=polsatsport.pl}} As well, the former [[Titan Fighting Championships#Welterweight Championship|Titan FC Welterweight Champion]] Uro\u0161 Juri\u0161i\u0107 made his KSW debut against Shamil Musaev who moved up welterweight for this fight.{{cite web |url=https://www.polsatsport.pl/wiadomosc/2021-01-07/ksw-58-shamil-musaev-kontra-uros-jurisic-w-rozpisce-gali/|title=KSW 58: Shamil Musaev vs. Uros Jurisic |date=7 January 2021 |access-date= 28 January 2021 |publisher=polsatsport.pl}}\n\nFormer [[Glory (kickboxing)|Glory]] and [[Ultimate Fighting Championship|UFC]] fighter [[Guto Inocente]] made his debut against the former KSW Heavyweight title challenger [[Micha\u0142 Andryszak]].{{cite web |last1=Cruz |first1=Guilherme |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2021/1/19/22237653/ufc-glory-guto-inocente-ksw-58-debut-michal-andryszak|title=UFC, GLORY veteran Guto Inocente set for KSW 58 debut against Michal Andryszak |date=19 January 2021 |access-date=28 January 2021 |publisher=mmafighting.com}}\n\n[[Francisco Albano Barrio]] has face Bart\u0142omiej Kopera in a lightweight bout.{{cite web |title=Najavljena borba Croate Barria za idu\u0107u KSW priredbu, \u010deka ga jo\u0161 jedan Poljak |url=https://fightsite.hr/fightsite/regija/najavljena-borba-croate-barria-za-iducu-ksw-priredbu-ceka-ga-jos-jedan-poljak-15041449 |website=fightsite.hr |date=8 January 2021 |access-date=9 January 2021}}\n\nPawe\u0142 Polity\u0142o has fought Dawid Martynik in the sole bantamweight bout of the card.{{cite web |last1=Szumowski |first1=Maciej |title=MMA. KSW 58. Pawe\u0142 Polity\u0142o zmierzy si\u0119 z Dawidem Martynikiem |url=https://sportowefakty.wp.pl/mma/918690/mma-ksw-58-pawel-politylo-zmierzy-sie-z-dawidem-martynikiem |website=sportowefakty.wp.pl |access-date=14 January 2021}}\n\nThe undefeated featherweight prospect [[Robert Rucha\u0142a]] made his sophomore appearance against the promotional newcomer Danijel Ba\u017eant.{{cite web [[Poland]]\n|attendance=\n|previousevent=\n|followingevent=\n}}\n''''''KSW 59: Fight Code'''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki March 20, 2021 at the [[Toya (company)#Wytw\u00f3rnia Club|Wytw\u00f3rnia Club]] in [[\u0141\u00f3d\u017a]], [[Poland]].\n\n===Background===\nIn the main event of the evening the former [[World's Strongest Man]] [[Mariusz Pudzianowski]] was set to return after a fifteen month layoff{{cite web |last1=MMA Fighting Newswire |title=Mariusz Pudzianowski returns to MMA after year-plus layoff |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2021/1/30/22258040/mariusz-pudzianowski-returns-to-mma-after-year-plus-layoff |website=mmafighting.com |date=31 January 2021 |access-date=31 January 2021}} against the undefeated Senegalese heavyweight Serigne Ousmane.{{cite web |last1=Zullino |first1=Alfredo |title=Mariusz Pudzianowski to clash with Senegalese wrestler at KSW 59 |url=https://www.bjpenn.com/mma-news/ksw/mariusz-pudzianowski-to-clash-with-senegalese-wrestler-at-ksw-59/ |website=bjpenn.com |access-date=16 February 2021}} However, on the day of the fight, Ousmane Dia suffered an acute appendicitis attack and had to be hospitalized. Stepping in on just a few hours notice was Serbia's Nikola Milanovic.{{cite web |last1=Alexander |first1=Mookie |title=KSW 59: 'Bombardier' hospitalized |url=https://www.bloodyelbow.com/2021/3/20/22341980/ksw-59-bombardier-hospitalized-mariusz-pudzianowski-fight-cancelled-mma-news |website=bloodyelbow.com |access-date=20 March 2021}}\n\nThe event co-headliner featured a rematch, Antun Ra\u010di\u0107 made the second defense of his the [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Bantamweight championship|KSW Bantamweight title]] against Sebastian Przybysz. Ra\u010di\u0107 won the first bout at [[2018 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 46: Narkun vs. Khalidov 2|KSW 46]] via unanimous decision.{{cite web |last1=Grejman|first1=Kinga |title=Oficjalnie: Sebastian Przybysz vs Antun Ra\u010di\u0107 na KSW 59|url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/mma-news/oficjalnie-sebastian-przybysz-vs-antun-racic-na-ksw-59|website=mmarocks.pl|date=11 February 2021 |access-date=11 February 2021}}\n\nFormer [[List of FFC champions#Heavyweight Championship|FFC Heavyweight champion]] [[Darko Sto\u0161i\u0107]] returned to heavyweight after an unsuccessful stint in [[UFC]] light heavyweight division. In his first fight in KSW the Serbian faced the polish Micha\u0142 W\u0142odarek.{{cite web |title=Micha\u0142 W\u0142odarek will face Darko Stosic at KSW 59 |url=https://inthecage.pl/michal-wlodarek-zmierzy-sie-z-darko-stosiciem-na-ksw-59/ |website=inthecage.pl |date=24 February 2021 |access-date=24 February 2021}}\n\nA middleweight fight between the Olympic medalist [[Damian Janikowski]] and the Bellator veteran Jason Radcliffe was part of the event.{{cite web |last1=Zubkiewicz |first1=Bart\u0142omiej |title=Damian Janikowski will face the hard-beating Jason Radcliffe at KSW 59! |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/damian-janikowski/damian-janikowski-zmierzy-sie-z-mocno-bijacym-jasonem-radcliffeem-na-ksw-59 |website=mmarocks.pl |access-date=25 February 2021 |archive-date=26 February 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210226035517/https://www.mmarocks.pl/damian-janikowski/damian-janikowski-zmierzy-sie-z-mocno-bijacym-jasonem-radcliffeem-na-ksw-59 |url-status=dead }}\n\nMichal Pietrzak faced the 26 year-old prospect Krystian Kaszubowski in a welterweight bout,{{cite web |last1=Bricker |first1=Matt |title=Welterweight Clash Set For KSW 59 |url=https://mmasucka.com/2021/02/23/ksw-59-adds-welterweight-fight/ |website=mmasucka.com |date=23 February 2021 |access-date=23 February 2021}} as well as welterweight bout between Lionel Padilla and the undefeated [[Adrian Bartosi\u0144ski]],{{cite web |last1=Cie\u015bla |first1=Bartosz |title=Adrian Bartosi\u0144ski kontra Lionel Padilla, \u0141ukasz Rajewski z nowym rywalem na KSW 59 |url=https://mma.pl/adrian-bartosinski-kontra-lionel-padilla-lukasz-rajewski-z-nowym-rywalem-na-ksw-59/ |website=mma.pl |date=8 March 2021 |access-date=8 March 2021}}\n\nThe Rajewski brothers will be back on the same card. The six-fight KSW veteran \u0141ukasz Rajewski is scheduled to fight the undefeated lightweight [[Mateusz Legierski]], in what will be his sophomore appearance with the organization.{{cite web |last1=Szumowski |first1=Maciej |title=MMA. KSW 59. \u0141ukasz Rajewski skrzy\u017cuje r\u0119kawice z Mateuszem Legierskim |url=https://sportowefakty.wp.pl/mma/925589/mma-ksw-59-lukasz-rajewski-skrzyzuje-rekawice-z-mateuszem-legierskim [[\u0141\u00f3d\u017a]], [[Poland]]\n|attendance=\n|previousevent=\n|followingevent=\n}}\n\n''''''KSW 60: De Fries vs. Narkun 2'''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki April 24, 2021 at the [[Toya (company)#Wytw\u00f3rnia Club|Wytw\u00f3rnia Club]] in [[\u0141\u00f3d\u017a]], [[Poland]].\n\n===Background===\nThe event was headlined by a rematch between Phil De Fries and Tomasz Narkun. The pair previously met on March 23, 2019 in the main event at [[2019 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 47: The X-Warriors|KSW 47: The X-Warriors]], where De Fries defeated Narkun by unanimous decision and defended his KSW heavyweight title.{{cite web |title=KSW 60: It's time for de Fries' big rematch with Narkun! |url=https://www.polsatsport.pl/wiadomosc/2021-03-29/ksw-60-czas-na-wielki-rewanz-de-friesa-z-narkunem/?ref=slider |website=polsatsport.pl | date=29 March 2021 |access-date=29 March 2021}}\n\nIn the co-main event, the reigning KSW Lightweight champion Marian Zi\u00f3\u0142kowski was scheduled to make his first title defense against Maciej Kazieczko.{{cite web |last1=Sporty walki |title=Marian Zi\u00f3\u0142kowski - Maciej Kazieczko: Pierwsze spotkanie twarz\u0105 w twarz |url=https://www.polsatsport.pl/film/marian-ziolkowski-maciej-kazieczko-pierwsze-spotkanie-twarza-w-twarz_6971471/ |website=polsatsport.pl |date=21 March 2021 |access-date=26 March 2021}} \t\n\nThe former boxer [[Izu Ugonoh]] was scheduled to make his sophomore MMA appearance against the undefeated heavyweight prospect Thomas Narmo,{{cite web |last1=Sporty walki |title=Izu Ugonoh - Thomas Narmo: Pierwsze spotkanie twarz\u0105 w twarz |url=https://www.polsatsport.pl/film/izu-ugonoh-thomas-narmo-pierwsze-spotkanie-twarza-w-twarz_6971466/ |website=polsatsport.pl |date=21 March 2021 |access-date=26 March 2021}} but Narmo was forced off the card on March 6 with a rib injury. The undefeated German U\u011fur \u00d6zkaplan was set to serve as Narmo's replacement.{{cite web |title=KSW 60: Izu Ugonoh with a new rival. Thomas Narmo injury |url=https://www.polsatsport.pl/wiadomosc/2021-04-06/izu-ugonoh-z-nowym-rywalem-na-ksw-60-zkaplan-wchodzi-w-miejsce-kontuzjowanego-narmo/ |website=polsatsport.pl |date=6 April 2021 |access-date=6 April 2021}} In turn, \u00d6zkaplan was replaced by Marek Samociuk.{{cite web |last1=Grabosz |first1=Rafa\u0142 |title=Zwyci\u0119zca turnieju walk na go\u0142e pi\u0119\u015bci nowym rywalem Izu Ugonoha na KSW 60 {{!}} MMAROCKS |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/mma-news/zwyciezca-turnieju-walk-na-gole-piesci-nowym-rywalem-ugonoha-na-ksw-60 |website=MMA Rocks! |access-date=20 April 2021 |language=pl-PL |date=20 April 2021}}\n\nTomasz Jakubiec was scheduled to fight Aleksandar Ili\u0107 at middleweight, with both fighters coming off of losses.{{cite web |title='Joker' ponovno u Fight'''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki June 5, 2021 at the [[Ergo Arena]] in [[Gda\u0144sk]], [[Poland]]. The event was planned to be held at the [[Gda\u0144sk Shakespeare Theatre]]. However, the event was moved to the Ergo Arena in Gdansk. On May 10 it was announced fans will be able to attend the event, KSW 61 will operate at a 50% capacity due to government guidelines.{{cite web |last1=Staff Report |title=Fans return at KSW 61: To Fight or Not To Fight |url=https://mymmanews.com/fans-return-at-ksw-61-to-fight-or-not-to-fight/ |website=mymmanews.com |date=11 May 2021 |access-date=13 May 2021}}\n\n===Background===\nThe main event featured a heavyweight bout between the former [[World's Strongest Man]] [[Mariusz Pudzianowski]] and KSW 1 tournament winner \u0141ukasz Jurkowski.{{cite web |last1=Anderson |first1=Jay |title=KSW 61 Announced for June, Pudzianowski vs. Jurkowski Headlines |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2021/04/24/ksw-61-announced-june-pudzianowski-vs-jurkowski-features/ |website=cagesidepress.com |date=24 April 2021 |access-date=25 April 2021}}\n\nTomasz Romanowski was scheduled to fight Patrik Kincl in a welterweight bout.{{cite web |last1=Stachura |first1=Bart\u0142omiej |title=Tomasz Romanowski vs. Patrik Kincl na KSW 61 |url=https://www.lowking.pl/tomasz-romanowski-vs-patrik-kincl-na-ksw-61/ |website=lowking.pl |access-date=10 May 2021}}\n\nA featherweight bout between Filip Peji\u0107 and the former KSW Featherweight champion [[Salahdine Parnasse]] was scheduled for the event.{{cite web |last1=Olkiewicz |first1=Mariusz |title=DONIESIENIA: Salahdine Parnasse vs. Filip Peji\u0107 na KSW 61 |url=https://inthecage.pl/doniesienia-parnasse-vs-pejic-na-ksw-61/ |website=inthecage.pl |date=11 May 2021 |access-date=12 May 2021}}\n\nTwo former KSW Light-heavyweight title challengers, Przemys\u0142aw Mysiala and Ivan Erslan, were scheduled to face each other.{{cite web |last1=Sobczak |first1=Bartosz |title=Ivan Erslan vs. Przemys\u0142aw Mysiala na KSW 61 [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki on July 17, 2021 at the ATM studio in [[Warsaw]], [[Poland]].\n\n===Background===\nThe event was headlined by a light heavyweight bout between [[Szymon Ko\u0142ecki]] and Akop Szostak.{{cite web |last1=Sporty walki |title=KSW 62: Szymon Ko\u0142ecki zmierzy si\u0119 z Akopem Szostakiem! Michalski was scheduled to face the undefeated [[Adrian Bartosi\u0144ski]] in a welterweight bout.{{cite web |last1=Sporty walki |title=KSW 62: Micha\u0142 Michalski zmierzy si\u0119 z Adrianem Bartosi\u0144skim |url=https://www.polsatsport.pl/wiadomosc/2021-06-22/ksw-62-michal-michalski-zmierzy-sie-z-adrianem-bartosinskim/ |website=polsatsport.pl |date=22 June 2021 |access-date=27 June 2021}}\n\nFormer kickboxer [[Tomasz Sarara]] made his mixed martial arts debut against Vladimir Toktasynov. The two of them fought in 2012, under kickboxing rules, with Toktasynov winning by decision.{{cite web |last1=Stachura |first1=Bart\u0142omiej |title=Tomasz Sarara zadebiutuje w formule MMA na KSW 62 \u2013 rywal ujawniony |url=https://www.lowking.pl/tomasz-sarara-zadebiutuje-w-formule-mma-na-ksw-62-rywal-ujawniony/ |website=lowking.pl |access-date=27 June 2021}}\n\nA lightweight bout between Sebastian Rajewski and the former KSW featherweight champion [[Artur Sowi\u0144ski (fighter)|Artur Sowi\u0144ski]] was announced for the event.{{cite web |last1=Cie\u015bla |first1=Bartosz Walki]]\n|date=September 4, 2021\n|venue=ATM studio\n|city={{flagicon|POL}} [[Warsaw]], [[Poland]]\n|attendance=\n|previousevent=\n|followingevent=\n}}\n\n'''''KSW 63: Crime of The Century''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki on September 4, 2021 at the ATM studio in [[Warsaw]], [[Poland]].\n\n===Background===\nThe event will feature a title fight between the reigning [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Welterweight championship|KSW Welterweight champion]] [[Roberto Soldi\u0107]] and the challenger Patrik Kincl as the event headliner.{{Cite web|last=|title=KSW 63: Znamy pierwsze szczeg\u00f3\u0142y gali. Wraca Roberto Soldi\u0107! - Polsat Sport|url=https://www.polsatsport.pl/wiadomosc/2021-07-17/ksw-63-znamy-pierwsze-szczegoly-gali-wraca-roberto-soldic/|url-status=live|access-date=2021-07-20|website=www.polsatsport.pl|date=17 July 2021 |language=pl|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210717182510/https://www.polsatsport.pl/wiadomosc/2021-07-17/ksw-63-znamy-pierwsze-szczegoly-gali-wraca-roberto-soldic/ |archive-date=2021-07-17 }}\n\nThe co-main event will feature Greco-Roman Olympic bronze medalist wrestler [[Damian Janikowski]] and the former [[Ultimate Fighting Championship|UFC]] fighter [[Pawe\u0142 Pawlak]] who makes his KSW debut.{{Cite web|last=Martin|first=Damon|date=2021-08-12|title=Olympic bronze medalist Damian Janikowski faces UFC fighter Pawel Pawlak at KSW 63|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2021/8/12/22621317/olympic-bronze-medalist-damian-janikowski-faces-ex-ufc-fighter-pawel-pawlak-at-ksw-63|access-date=2021-08-12|website=MMA Fighting|language=en}}\n\nThe heavyweight contender [[Darko Sto\u0161i\u0107]] will fight against [[Micha\u0142 Andryszak]] at the event.{{cite web |title=Zasad ni\u0161ta od napada na titulu, Darko Sto\u0161i\u0107 protiv Michala Andryszaka na KSW 63 priredbi |url=https://fightsite.hr/fightsite/regija/zasad-nista-od-napada-na-titulu-darko-stosic-protiv-michala-andryszaka-na-ksw-63-priredbi-15095343 |website=fightsite.hr |date=16 August 2021 |access-date=23 August 2021}}\n\nAlso, a two Croatian bout is scheduled for the event. First, the former KSW Bantamweight champion Antun Ra\u010di\u0107 is scheduled to face Jakub Wik\u0142acz in a bantamweight bout{{cite web |title=Antun Ra\u010di\u0107 pridru\u017euje se Robertu Soldi\u0107u na priredbi u Var\u0161avi, 'Killera' \u010deka opasni Poljak |url=https://fightsite.hr/fightsite/regija/antun-racic-pridruzuje-se-robertu-soldicu-na-priredbi-u-varsavi-killera-ceka-opasni-poljak-15094103 |website=fightsite.hr |date=10 August 2021 |access-date=11 August 2021}} and in an 80 kg catchweight bout between Aleksandar Rakas will face Tomasz Romanowski.{{cite web |title=Tomasz Romanowski to face Aleksandar Rakas at KSW 63 |url=https://mma-root.com/tomasz-romanowski-to-face-aleksandar-rakas-at-ksw-63/ |website=mma-root.com |access-date=23 August 2021}}\n\nTwo women's flyweight bouts were scheduled for the event. First, Emilia Czerwi\u0144ska would face Weronika Esze,{{cite web |title=KSW 63: Emilia Czerwi\u0144ska i Weronika Eszer zmierz\u0105 si\u0119 na gali Santos''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki on October 23, 2021 at the [[Atlas Arena]] in [[\u0141\u00f3d\u017a]], [[Poland]].\n\n===Background===\nA bantamweight title fight between the reigning champion Sebastian Przybysz and challenger Bruno Augusto dos Santos was announced as the main event.{{cite web |last1=Johnny |first1=Jack |title=Sebastian Przybysz with a new fight of the evening of KSW 64 against Bruno Augusto dos Santos |url=https://mma-root.com/sebastian-przybysz-with-a-new-fight-of-the-evening-of-ksw-64-against-bruno-augusto-dos-santos/ |website=mma-root.com |access-date=29 September 2021}}\n\nA heavyweight bout between Serigne Ousmane Dia and five-time [[World's Strongest Man]] titlist [[Mariusz Pudzianowski]] was scheduled as the co-main event. The two were originally set to fight at KSW 59, before Dia withdrew.{{cite web |title=Poku\u0161aj broj dva: KSW jo\u0161 jednom ugovorio Pudzianowskog protiv senegalskog gorostasa |url=https://fightsite.hr/fightsite/ostalo/pokusaj-broj-dva-ksw-jos-jednom-ugovorio-pudzianowskog-protiv-senegalskog-gorostasa-15104089 |website=fightsite.hr |date=22 September 2021 |access-date=29 September 2021}}\n\nKSW veteran Filip Peji\u0107 was scheduled to face promotional newcomer [[Daniel Rutkowski]] in a featherweight bout.{{cite web |title=Filip Peji\u0107 idu\u0107eg mjeseca u KSW borili\u0161tu, \u010deka ga najopasnije poja\u010danje poljske promocije |url=https://fightsite.hr/fightsite/regija/filip-pejic-iduceg-mjeseca-u-ksw-borilistu-ceka-ga-najopasnije-pojacanje-poljske-promocije-15105858 |website=fightsite.hr |date=28 September 2021 |access-date=29 September 2021}}\n\nA featherweight bout between [[Robert Rucha\u0142a]] and [[Patryk Kaczmarczyk]] was announced for the event. The two of them fought as amateurs, at Thunderstrike Fight League 15 on October 20, 2018, with Kaczmarczyk winning by unanimous decision.{{cite web |last1=Sporty walki |title=KSW 64: Patryk Kaczmarczyk i Robert Rucha\u0142a o rewan\u017cu. \"Wtedy byli\u015bmy dzie\u0107mi...\" |url=https://www.polsatsport.pl/wiadomosc/2021-09-27/ksw-64-patryk-kaczmarczyk-i-robert-ruchala-o-rewanzu-wtedy-bylismy-dziecmi/ |website=polsatsport.pl |date=27 September 2021 |access-date=29 September 2021}}\n\nA welterweight bout between Micha\u0142 Pietrzak and Shamil Musaev was scheduled for the event.{{cite web |last1=Sobczak |first1=Bartosz |title=Micha\u0142 Pietrzak vs. Shamil Musaev na KSW 64 w \u0141odzi |url=https://mymma.pl/michal-pietrzak-vs-shamil-musaev-na-ksw-64-w-lodzi/ |website=mymma.pl |date=16 September 2021 |access-date=29 September 2021}}\n\nTwo middleweight bouts were announced for the event: Cezary K\u0119sik was scheduled to face Marcin Krakowiak,{{cite web |last1=Sporty walki |title=KSW 64: Marcin Krakowiak zmierzy si\u0119 z Cezarym K\u0119sikiem |url=https://www.polsatsport.pl/wiadomosc/2021-09-20/ksw-64-marcin-krakowiak-zmierzy-sie-z-cezarym-kesikiem/ |website=polsatsport.pl |date=20 September 2021 |access-date=29 September 2021}} while Albert Odzimkowski was scheduled to face Jason Radcliffe.{{cite web |last1=Johnny |first1=Jack |title=Albert Odzimkowski vs. Jason Radcliffe added to KSW 64 roster Zi\u00f3\u0142kowski vs. Ma\u0144kowski|KSW 66]]\n}}\n\n'''''KSW 65: Khalidov vs. Soldi\u0107''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki on December 18, 2021 at [[Gliwice Arena]] in [[Gliwice]], [[Poland]].\n\n===Background===\nThe event featured two title fights, first a [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Middleweight championship|KSW Middleweight Championship]] bout between the reigning champion [[Mamed Khalidov]] and the [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Welterweight championship|KSW Welterweight Champion]] [[Roberto Soldi\u0107]] as the event headliner.{{cite web |title=KSW 65 set for Dec. 18; headliner billed as 'biggest fight in the history' of promotion |url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2021/11/ksw-65-mamed-khalidov-roberto-soldic-biggest-fight-in-history |website=mmajunkie.usatoday.com |access-date=4 December 2021}} Secondly, a rematch for the [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Featherweight championship|KSW Featherweight Championship]] between the champion Daniel Torres and the former Champion [[Salahdine Parnasse]] as the event co-headliner.{{cite web |title=SALAHDINE PARNASSE POUR LA REVANCHE FACE \u00c0 TORRES LE 18 D\u00c9CEMBRE ! |url=https://lasueur.com/salahdine-parnasse-daniel-torres-23-10-2021 |website=lasueur.com |date=23 October 2021 |access-date=4 December 2021 |language=french}} Daniel Torres came in at 146 pounds, a pound over championship weight and was stripped of the title, only Parnasse was able to win the belt.{{Cite web|last=Sherdog.com|title=KSW 65 Weigh-in Results: Daniel Torres Loses Belt on Scale|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/KSW-65-Weighin-Results-Daniel-Torres-Loses-Belt-on-Scale-183637|access-date=2021-12-17|website=Sherdog}}\n\nOn December 5, it was announced that Ion Surdu had suffered an injury in training and was pulling out of his bout with Adam Nied\u017awied\u017a. Surdu was replaced by Miroslav Bro\u017e against Nied\u017awied\u017a.{{cite web |last1=Pawlowski |first1=Kamil |title=Miroslav Bro\u017e is Adam Nied\u017awiedzi's new rival at KSW 65 |url=https://inthecage.pl/miroslav-broz-nowym-rywalem-adama-niedzwiedzia-na-ksw-65/ |website=inthecage.pl |date=9 December 2021 |access-date=10 December 2021 |language=polish}}\n\nA featherweight bout between Patryk Likus and Luke Santarelli was expected to take place at this event.{{cite web |title=Patryk Likus returns to action at KSW 65! Rival debuting in the organization |url=https://inthecage.pl/patryk-likus-wraca-do-akcji-na-ksw-65-rywalem-debiutujacy-w-organizacji-santarelli/ |website=inthecage.pl |date=26 November 2021 |access-date=11 December 2021 |language=polish}} On December 10, Santarelli withdrew due to an injury and was replaced by Alexander L\u00f6\u00f6f.{{cite web |title=Patryk Likus will face a new rival at KSW 65 |url=https://www.fight24.pl/patryk-likus-zmierzy-sie-z-nowym-rywalem-na-ksw-65/ |website=fight24.pl |access-date=11 December 2021 |language=polish}} However, in turn, L\u00f6\u00f6f has to withdraw on December 16, he was replaced by Hassan Shaaban who steps in on just a few days notice to make his KSW debut against Likus.{{cite web |last1=Zejma |first1=Kamil |title=Another change of rival Patryk Likus! Hassan Shaaban comes into play |url=https://inthecage.pl/kolejna-zmiana-rywala-patryka-likusa-hassan-shaaban-wchodzi-do-gry/ |website=inthecage.pl |date=16 December 2021 |access-date=16 December 2021}} Hassan Shaaban in turn missed weight and was replaced by Piotr Olszynka.\n\n'''Bonus awards'''\n\nThe following fighters were awarded bonuses:\n* '''Fight of the Night:''' Lom Ali Eskiev vs. Ma\u0144kowski==\n{{Infobox MMA event\n|name=KSW 66: Zi\u00f3\u0142kowski vs. Ma\u0144kowski\n|image=\n|promotion=[[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki]]\n|date=January 15, 2022\n|venue= [[Netto 66: Zi\u00f3\u0142kowski vs. Ma\u0144kowski''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki on January 15, 2022, at [[Netto Arena]] in [[Szczecin]], [[Poland]].\n\n===Background===\nThe event featured two title fights. First, a [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Lightweight championship|KSW Lightweight Championship]] title bout between reigning champion Marian Zi\u00f3\u0142kowski and title challenger Borys Ma\u0144kowski was scheduled as the event headliner.{{cite web |last1=Stachura |first1=Bart\u0142omiej |title=Marian Zi\u00f3\u0142kowski vs. Borys Ma\u0144kowski na KSW 66 |url=https://www.lowking.pl/marian-ziolkowski-vs-borys-mankowski-na-ksw-66/ |website=lowking.pl |access-date=17 December 2021}} The co-main event featured a light heavyweight bout for the [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Light heavyweight championship|KSW Light Heavyweight Championship]] between the reigning champion Tomasz Narkun and the challenger [[Ibragim Chuzhigaev]].{{cite web |last1=Leonte |first1=Tudor |title=Sources: Tomasz Narkun-Ibragim Chuzhigaev Light Heavyweight Title Tilt Set for KSW 66 |url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Sources-Tomasz-NarkunIbragim-Chuzhigaev-Light-Heavyweight-Title-Tilt-Set-for-KSW-66-183774 |website=sherdog.com |access-date=29 April 2022}}{{cite web |title=KSW 66 weigh-in results: Two title fights set in Poland |url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2022/01/ksw-66-weigh-in-results-two-title-fights-set-in-poland |website=mmajunkie.usatoday.com |date=14 January 2022 |access-date=30 April 2022}}\n\nRafa\u0142 Moks was expected to fight at the event. However, on December 17, ksw sports director Wojs\u0142aw Rysiewski announced Moks' withdrawal from the bout due an injury.{{cite web |last1=Zejma |first1=Kamil |title=Rafa\u0142 Moks injured \u2013 falls out of KSW 66 |url=https://inthecage.pl/rafal-moks-kontuzjowany-wypada-z-ksw-66/ |website=inthecage.pl |access-date=20 December 2021}}\n\nWojciech Janusz was originally supposed to compete in a light heavyweight bout against Przemys\u0142aw Dzwonarek. However, Dzwonarek has to withdraw due to undisclosed reason. Damian Skar\u017cy\u0144ski stepped in at short notice to face Wojciech Janusz; the duel was a catchweight of 98 kg.{{cite web |last1=\u0141yko |first1=Marek |title=WOJCIECH JANUSZ VS. DAMIAN SKAR\u017bY\u0143SKI AT KSW 66! |url=https://naszemma.pl/2022/01/wojciech-janusz-vs-damian-skarzynski-na-ksw-66/ |website=naszemma.pl |date=14 January 2022 |access-date=15 January 2022}}\n\nA welterweight bout between Tomasz Romanowski and Krystian Kaszubowski was planned for the event. However, Romanowski was forced to withdraw from the fight for medical reasons. Robert Maciejowski stepped in and fought Kaszubowski at middleweight.{{cite web |last1=Nowosielski |first1=Tomasz |title=Tomasz Romanowski leaves the KSW 66 gala \u2013 Krystian Kaszubowski with a new opponent |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/mma-news/tomasz-romanowski-wypada-z-gali-ksw-66-krystian-kaszubowski-z-nowym-przeciwnikiem |website=mmarocks.pl |date=14 January 2022 |access-date=15 January 2022 |language=polish}}\n\n'''Bonus awards'''\n\nThe following fighters were awarded bonuses:{{cite web |last1=Sobczak |first1=Bartosz |title=Bonuses for knockout, submission and fight of the evening KSW 66 |url=https://mymma.pl/bonusy-za-nokaut-poddanie-i-walke-wieczoru-ksw-66-video/ |website=mymma.pl |date=18 January 2022 |access-date=29 April 2022}}\n* '''Fight of the Night:''' Ibragim Chuzhigaev vs. Tomasz Narkun\n* '''Submission of the Night:''' Donovan Desmae\n* '''Knockout of the Night:''' Gracjan Szadzi\u0144ski\n\n===Results===\n{| class=\"wikitable\" style=\"font-size: 80%;\"\n|-\n! |url=https://fightsite.hr/fightsite/regija/napokon-je-potvrdeno-darko-stosic-borit-ce-se-za-ksw-ov-pojas-teske-kategorije-15145846 |website=fightsite.hr |access-date=19 January 2022 |date=15 January 2022}}\n\nA featherweight bout between Krzysztof Klaczek and Dawid \u015amie\u0142owski was planned for the event. However, on February 8, Klaczek has to withdraw from the fight due to illness. Filip Peji\u0107 stepped in for Klaczek, the bout will now be contest at 68.5 kg limit.{{cite web |title=Filip Pejic performs at KSW this month: He will seek a break in his losing streak against the undefeated Pole |url=https://fightsite.hr/fightsite/regija/filip-pejic-ovaj-mjesec-nastupa-u-ksw-u-prekid-gubitnickog-niza-trazit-ce-protiv-neporazenog-poljaka-15155511 |website=fightsite.hr |date=8 February 2022 |access-date=9 February 2022}}\n\nA light heavyweight bout between Hasan Mezhiev and Ivan Erslan was scheduled for the event.{{cite web |last1=Erslan |first1=John |title=Croatian decided to complete the contract with Polish promotion |url=https://fightsite.hr/fightsite/regija/ivan-erslan-vec-ovog-mjeseca-u-ksw-ovom-borilistu-ceka-ga-jedna-od-najtezih-borbi-karijere-15152593 |website=fightsite.hr |date=February 2022 |access-date=28 February 2022}} However, on February 24, Mezhiev was removed from the contest due to testing positive for COVID-19. He was replaced by Caio Bitencourt.{{cite web |last1=Zubek |first1=Anthony |title=New rivals of Michaliszyn and Erslan at KSW 67 |url=https://silesion.pl/nowi-rywale-michaliszyna-i-erslana-na-ksw-67/ |website=silesion.pl |date=23 February 2022 |access-date=28 February 2022}} However, in turn, Bitencourt fell ill during his weight cut and has to withdraw from the fight, the bout was cancelled.{{cite web |last1=TREESE |first1=TYLER |title=KSW 67 Weigh-in Results: 3 Fighters Heavy; 1 Bout Canceled |url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/KSW-67-Weighin-Results-3-Fighters-Heavy-1-Bout-Canceled-184908 |website=sherdog.com |access-date=28 February 2022}}\n\nThree fighters who missed weight are: Andrzej Grzebyk, who missed weight by one pound (77.9 kg/172 lb) and was fined 30% of his purse, Filip Pejic, who missed weight by one pound (69 kg/152 lb), and was also fined 30% of his purse, and finally, Idris Amizhaev \u2014 who missed weight by a full seven pounds heavy (82.9 kg/183 lb) for a 176 lb catchweight, and was fined 50% of his purse.{{Cite web |last=Staff |date=2022-02-25 |title=Three Fighters Heavy, Bout Cancelled Ahead of KSW 67 |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2022/02/25/three-fighters-heavy-bout-cancelled-ahead-ksw-67/ |access-date=2022-02-26 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US}}\n\n'''Bonus awards'''\n\nThe following fighters were awarded bonuses:{{cite web |last1=Nowosielski |first1=Tomasz |title=Young wolves enter KSW and collect bonuses for fights \u2013 Dawid \u015amie\u0142owski after winning at KSW 67 |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/ksw-67/mlode-wilki-wchodza-do-ksw-i-zgarniaja-bonusy-za-walki-dawid-smielowski-po-wygranej-na-ksw-67 |website=mmarocks.pl |date=26 February 2022 |access-date=29 April 2022}}\n* '''Fight of the Night:''' Dawid \u015amie\u0142owski vs. Filip Peji\u0107\n* '''Submission of the Night:''' [[Adrian Bartosi\u0144ski]]\n* '''Knockout of the Night:''' Adam Soldaev\n\n===Results===\n{| class=\"wikitable\" style=\"font-size: 80%;\"\n|-\n! However, on February 28, Musaev was removed from the card Because of the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]].{{cite web |title=KSW announces 'ethically justifiable' decision to cancel Russian fighter's bout amid invasion of Ukraine |url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2022/02/ksw-cancels-russian-fighter-bout-over-ukraine-invasion |website=mmajunkie.usatoday.com |date=28 February 2022 |access-date=30 April 2022}}\n\n'''Bonus awards'''\n\nThe following fighters were awarded bonuses:{{cite web |title=Bonuses after the KSW 68 gala |url=https://www.fight24.pl/bonusy-po-gali-ksw-68/ |website=fight24.pl |access-date=29 April 2022}}\n* '''Fight of the Night:''' Damian Janikowski vs Tomasz Jakubiec \n* '''Submission of the Night:''' Salahdine Parnasse\n* '''Knockout of the Night:''' Damian Janikowski\n\n===Results===\n{| class=\"wikitable\" style=\"font-size: 80%;\"\n|-\n! Trailer pojedynku Sebastian Przybysz vs Zuriko Jojua. \"Jeszcze jedna walka i rzucam to wszystko\" |url=https://gazetawroclawska.pl/ksw-69-trailer-pojedynku-sebastian-przybysz-vs-zuriko-jojua-jeszcze-jedna-walka-i-rzucam-to-wszystko/ar/c2-16254375 |website=gazetawroclawska.pl |access-date=9 April 2022 |date=8 April 2022}} but Jojua had to withdraw due to a rib injury. Werlleson Martins makes his debut on short notice against Przybysz,{{cite web |title=Werlleson Martins steps in to challenge Sebastian Przybysz |url=https://fight-madness.com/werlleson-martins-steps-in-to-challenge-sebastian-przybysz/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220426030659/https://fight-madness.com/werlleson-martins-steps-in-to-challenge-sebastian-przybysz/ |url-status=usurped |archive-date=April 26, 2022 |website=fight-madness.com |date=15 April 2022 |access-date=18 April 2022}} the title fight served as the main event.\n\nA middleweight bout between [[Pawe\u0142 Pawlak]] and Cezary K\u0119sik was scheduled as the co-main event.{{cite web |last1=\u0141osak |first1=Jacek |title=\"Jeden z trudniejszych rywali w KSW\" \u2013 Pawlak o walce z K\u0119sikiem na KSW 69 Walki on May 28, 2022, at the [[Atlas Arena]] in [[\u0141\u00f3d\u017a]], [[Poland]].\n\n===Background===\nThe main event featured a heavyweight superfight between the former [[World's Strongest Man]] [[Mariusz Pudzianowski]] and the former [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Middleweight championship|KSW Middleweight Champion]] [[Micha\u0142 Materla]].{{cite web |last1=Critchfield |first1=Tristen |title=Strongman Mariusz Pudzianowski to Meet Ex-Middleweight Champ Michal Materla at KSW 70 |url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Strongman-Mariusz-Pudzianowski-to-Meet-ExMiddleweight-Champ-Michal-Materla-at-KSW-70-185915 |website=sherdog.com |access-date=30 April 2022}}\n\nThe co-main event featured the return to KSW of Daniel Omiela\u0144czuk against the former [[Chelsea F.C.]] goalkeeper Ricardo Prasel.{{cite web |last1=Cruz |first1=Guilherme |title=Former UFC hopeful Ricardo Prasel |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2022/5/27/23144503/once-ufc-hopeful-ricardo-prasel-build-career-make-money-ksw |website=mmafighting.com |date=27 May 2022 |access-date=28 May 2022}}\n\nThe undefeated prospect Radoslaw Paczuski would welcome the former [[Glory (kickboxing)#Glory Middleweight Championship|Glory Middleweight Champion]] [[Jason Wilnis]] to the KSW middleweight division.{{cite web |last1=Martin |first1=Damon |title=Ex-GLORY champion Jason Wilnis signs with KSW, set for debut at KSW 70 on May 28 |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2022/4/28/23045759/ex-glory-champion-jason-wilnis-signs-with-ksw-set-for-debut-at-ksw-70-on-may-28 |website=mmafighting.com |date=28 April 2022 |access-date=30 April 2022}}\n\nSofiia Bagishvili was expected to face Anita Bekus in a flyweight bout at the event.{{cite web |title=KSW 70 in Atlas Arena. Historical clash with the participation of a Lodz girl |url=https://www.radiolodz.pl/sport/78780-ksw-70-w-atlas-arenie-lodzianka-sprawdzi-forme-debiutantki-z-gruzji |website=radiolodz.pl |access-date=28 May 2022}} However, Bagishvili pulled out a week before the event due to a wrist injury and she was replaced by promotional newcomer Roberta Zocco.{{cite web |title=Anita Bekus with a new rival for the KSW 70 gala |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/ksw-70/anita-bekus-z-nowa-rywalka-na-gale-ksw-70 |website=mmarocks.pl |access-date=28 May 2022}}\n\n'''Bonus awards'''\n\nThe following fighters were awarded bonuses:\n* '''Submission of the Night:''' Francisco Barrio & Ricardo Prasel\n* '''Knockout of the Night:''' Ivan Erslan & Mariusz Pudzianowski\n\n===Results===\n{| class=\"wikitable\" style=\"font-size: 80%;\"\n|-\n! He was replaced by Sebastian Rajewski and the bout was for the interim KSW Lightweight title.{{cite web |last1=Anderson |first1=Jay |title=KSW 76 Sees Main Event Change, Salahdine Parnasse vs. Sebastian Rajewski Now Fight for Interim Lightweight Title |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2022/10/14/ksw-76-sees-main-event-change-salahdine-parnasse-vs-sebastian-rajewski-now-fight-interim-lightweight-title/ |website=cagesidepress.com |date=14 October 2022 |access-date=28 October 2022}}{{cite web |last1=Angelini |first1=Olivier |title=Ziolkowski forfait, Salahdine Parnasse affrontera Sebastian Rajewski pour la ceinture int\u00e9rim du KSW |url=https://boxemag.com/mma/ziolkowski-forfait-salahdine-parnasse-affrontera-sebastian-rajewski-pour-la-ceinture-interim-du-ksw/ |website=boxemag.com |date=17 October 2022 |access-date=28 October 2022 |language=french}}\n\n[[Bartosz Le\u015bko]] was set to face Pawe\u0142 Pawlak in a middleweight bout,{{cite web |last1=Tkaczuk |first1=Micha\u0142 |title=Pawe\u0142 Pawlak i Bartosz Le\u015bko zmierz\u0105 si\u0119 w starciu w wadze \u015bredniej na KSW 76 |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/mma-news/pawel-pawlak-i-bartosz-lesko-zmierza-sie-w-starciu-w-wadze-sredniej-na-ksw-76 |website=mmarocks.pl |date=11 October 2022 |access-date=28 October 2022}} however Le\u015bko suffered a hand injury and have to withdraw from the fight. Tom Breese steep in to replaced Le\u015bko against Pawlak.{{cite web |last1=Cie\u015bla |first1=Bartosz |title=Pawe\u0142 Pawlak z nowym rywalem na gali KSW 76 |url=https://mma.pl/pawel-pawlak-z-nowym-rywalem-na-gali-ksw-76/ |website=mma.pl |date=21 October 2022 |access-date=28 October 2022 |language=polish}}\n\nA Heavyweight bout between Filip Bradaric and Marek Samociuk was scheduled for this event.{{cite web |title=Croatian MMA stars in action at KSW 76 |url=https://www.croatiaweek.com/croatian-mma-stars-in-action-at-ksw-76/ |website=croatiaweek.com |date=10 November 2022 |access-date=12 November 2022}} However, a week before the event Bradaric pulled out of the bout due to injury and was replaced by Kamil Gawryjo\u0142ek.{{cite web |last1=CARPENTER |first1=BARTOSZ |title=Undefeated Kamil Gawryjo\u0142ek is Marek Samociuk's new rival at KSW 76 |url=https://mma.pl/niepokonany-kamil-gawryjolek-nowym-rywalem-marka-samociuka-na-ksw-76/ |website=mma.pl |date=8 November 2022 |access-date=12 November 2022}}\n\n'''Bonus awards'''\n\nThe following fighters were awarded bonuses:\n* '''Fight of the Night:''' Maciej Kazieczko vs. [[Francisco Albano Barrio]]\n* '''Submission of the Night:''' Henry Fadipe\n* '''Knockout of the Night:''' Artur June 3, 2023\n|venue= [[PGE Narodowy]]\n|city={{flagicon|POL}} [[Warsaw]], [[Poland]] \n|attendance=\n|previousevent=\n|followingevent=\n}}\n'''XTB KSW 83: Colosseum 2''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki on June 3, 2023, at the [[PGE Narodowy]] in [[Warsaw]], [[Poland]].\n\n===Background===\nThree KWS title fights were scheduled for the event: a [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Lightweight championship|KSW Lightweight Championship]] bout between champion Marian Zi\u00f3\u0142kowski and interim champion [[Salahdine Parnasse]];{{cite web |last1=Martin |first1=Paul |title=Marian Zi\u00f3\u0142kowski vs Salahdine Parnasse booked for KSW 76 |url=https://mmadissect.com/articles/marian-zikowski-vs-salahdine-parnasse-booked-for-ksw-76 |access-date=April 30, 2023 |website=mmadissect.com}} a [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Middleweight championship|KSW Middleweight championship]] bout between champion [[Pawe\u0142 Pawlak]] and challenger Tomasz Romanowski;{{cite web |last1=Stachura |first1=Bart\u0142omiej |date=April 14, 2023 |title=Pawe\u0142 Pawlak vs. Tomasz Romanowski na KSW Koloseum 2 na Stadionie Narodowym! |url=https://www.lowking.pl/pawel-pawlak-vs-tomasz-romanowski-na-ksw-koloseum-2-na-stadionie-narodowym/ |access-date=April 30, 2023 |website=lowking.pl}} as well as a [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Bantamweight championship|KSW Bantamweight Championship]] between champion Jakub Wik\u0142acz and Werlleson Martins.{{cite web |last1=Zubek |first1=Antoni |date=April 26, 2023 |title=Werlleson Martins nowym rywalem mistrza wagi koguciej, Jakuba Wik\u0142acza na XTB KSW Colosseum 2 |url=https://silesion.pl/werlleson-martins-nowym-rywalem-mistrza-wagi-koguciej-jakuba-wiklacza-na-xtb-ksw-colosseum-2/ |access-date=April 30, 2023 |website=silesion.pl}} However, Martins wasn't medically cleared after issues with the weight cut and the bout was scrapped.{{cite web |date=June 2, 2023 |title=KSW Colosseum 2 Weigh-In Results \u2014 Card Official, But One Title Fight Lost |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2023/06/02/ksw-colosseum-2-weigh-results-card-official-one-title-fight-lost/ |publisher=cagesidepress.com}} Additionally, Zi\u00f3\u0142kowski injured his knee in the locker room while warming up for the championship bout, and subsequently relinquished the title.{{cite web |author=Dan Hiergesell |date=June 3, 2023 |title=KSW Coliseum 2's massive co-main event abruptly canceled after freak locker room injury |url=https://www.mmamania.com/2023/6/3/23748104/fighter-blows-out-knee-warm-up-locker-room-massive-co-main-event-abruptly-canceled-ksw-coliseum-2-83 |publisher=mmamania.com}}\n\nA heavyweight bout between [[Arkadiusz Wrzosek]] and former two-time world kickboxing champion [[Bogdan Stoica]] is expected to take place at the event. Stoica will make his MMA and promotional debut.{{cite web |date=April 28, 2023 |title=Arek Wrzosek treft kickboks fenomeen Bogdan Stoica tijdens KSW Colosseum 2 |url=https://www.vechtsportinfo.nl/mma-nieuws/arek-wrzosek-treft-kickboks-fenomeen-bogdan-stoica-tijdens-xtb-ksw-colosseum-2 |website=vechtsportinfo.nl |language=Dutch}}\n\n'''Bonus awards'''\n\nThe \n|attendance=\n|previousevent=\n|followingevent=\n}}\n\n'''KSW 86: Wik\u0142acz vs. Przybysz 4''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki on September 16, 2023, at the [[Hala Orbita]] in [[Wroc\u0142aw]], [[Poland]].\n\n===Background===\n\nA tetralogy bout for [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Bantamweight championship|KSW Bantamweight Championship]] between current champion Jakub Wik\u0142acz and former champion Sebastian Przybysz was booked as the event headliner. The pairing first met at [[2017 in Absolute Championship Berkut#ACB 63: Celi\u0144ski vs. Magalhaes|ACB 63]] on July 1, 2017, which ended in a unanimous decision in favor of Wik\u0142acz. Their second meeting took place at [[2020 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 53: Reborn|KSW 53: Reborn]] on July 11, 2020, where Przybysz won by TKO in the third round. Their third meeting took place at [[2022 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 77: Khalidov vs. Pudzianowski|KSW 77]] on December 17, 2022, where Wik\u0142acz captured the title by split decision.{{cite web |author=Micha\u0142 Tkaczuk |date=August 7, 2023 |title=Wielkie starcie na szczycie wagi koguciej walk\u0105 wieczoru gali KSW 86 |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/mma-news/wielkie-starcie-na-szczycie-wagi-koguciej-walka-wieczoru-gali-ksw-86 |publisher=mmarocks.pl}}\n\n'''Bonus awards'''\n\nThe following fighters were awarded [[Gliwice]], Poland \n|attendance=\n|previousevent=\n|followingevent=\n}}\n\n'''XTB KSW Epic: Khalidov vs. Adamek''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki on February 24, 2024, at the [[Gliwice Arena]] in [[Gliwice]], Poland.\n\n===Background===\n\nTo celebrate the twentieth anniversary of the [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki|KSW]] brand, the XTB KSW Epic gala was announced.{{Cite web |title=Starcie muay thai w r\u0119kawicach do MMA na gali XTB KSW Epic {{!}} KSW |url=https://www.kswmma.com/news/4918/starcie-muay-thai-w-rekawicach-do-mma-na-gali-xtb-ksw-epic#! reigning champion [[Adrian Bartosi\u0144ski]] and #1 contender Andrzej Grzebyk was expected to headline the event. The pairing previously fought at [[2022 in Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#KSW 67: De Fries vs. Sto\u0161i\u0107|KSW 67]] in February 2022, where Bartosi\u0144ski won via submission in the second round. However, Grzebyk withdrew due to injury and was replaced by #3 contender [[Igor Michaliszyn]].{{cite web|url=https://mma.pl/nowa-walka-wieczoru-michaliszyn-kontra-bartosinski-na-ksw-94/|title=Nowa walka wieczoru. ==\n{{Infobox MMA event\n|name= Cage Warriors 196: London\n|image= \n|promotion= [[Cage Warriors]]\n|date= {{start date|2025|11|15}}\n|venue= [[The O2#Indigo at The O2|Indigo at The O2]]\n|city= [[London]], England\n|attendance= \n|gate=\n|previousevent= \n|followingevent= \n}}\n'''''Cage Warriors 196: London''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event promoted by [[Cage Warriors]] that took place on November 15, 2025, in [[London]], England.\n\n===Background===\nA [[Cage Warriors#Cage Warriors Bantamweight Championship|Cage Warriors Bantamweight Championship]] bout for the vacant title between Shirzad Qadrian and Elton Armindo was scheduled to headline the event.{{Cite web |date=2025-11-11 |title=CW 196: London \u2013 Final Card & Broadcast Times |url=https://cagewarriors.com/cw-196-london-final-card-broadcast-times/ |access-date=2025-11-12 |website=Cage Warriors |language=en}} However, at the weigh-ins, both fighters were missed weight when Qadrian registered at 138.1 lbs, while Armindo came in heavier at 142.8 lbs. Therefore, the bout was subsequently cancelled.{{Cite web |date=2025-11-14 |title=CW 196: London: Weigh-In Results |url=https://cagewarriors.com/cw-196-london-weigh-in-results/ |access-date=2025-11-12 |website=Cage Warriors |language=en}}\n\nAs a results, a 160 pounds catchweight bout between former featherweight champion Jordan Vucenic and undefeated prospect Torpal Merjoev was promoted to new main event instead.\n\nA [[Cage Warriors#Cage Warriors Featherweight Championship|Cage Warriors Featherweight Championship]] bout for the vacant title between Nik Bagley and Solomon Simon was scheduled to serve as the co-main event.{{Cite web |date=2025-10-10 |title=Cage Warriors Announce Two Colossal Title Fights in November |url=https://www.lowkickmma.com/cage-warriors-announce-title-fights-in-november/ |access-date=2025-10-12 |website=www.lowkickmma.com |language=en-US}} Former champion Harry Hardwick vacated his title when he stepped in on short notice to face Kau\u00ea Fernandes at [[UFC Fight Night: Imavov vs. Borralho]].{{Cite web |last=Richardson |first=Andrew |date=2025-09-02 |title=Highly-touted Cage Warriors champ swoops in to save UFC Paris match up |url=https://www.mmamania.com/latest-news/386527/highly-touted-cage-warriors-champ-swoops-in-to-save-ufc-paris-match-up |access-date=2025-10-12 |website=MMAmania.com |language=en}} However, Bagley withdrew from the bout and was replaced by Caique Araujo. At the weigh-ins, Araujo weighed in at 146.9 pounds, 1.9 pounds over the limit. As a result, Araujo was ineligible for the title and only Simon was eligible to win the vacant title.\n\n===Results===\n{{MMAevent}}\n{{MMAevent card|Main card (UFC Fight Pass)}}\n{{MMAevent \n}}\n'''''Cage Warriors 197: Unplugged''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event promoted by [[Cage Warriors]] that took place on November 21, 2025, in [[Manchester]], England.\n\n===Background===\nA [[Cage Warriors#Cage Warriors Lightweight Championship|Cage Warriors Lightweight Championship]] title unification bout between current champion Samuel Silva and interim title holder Omar Turgarev was scheduled to headline the event. However, Silva was forced to withdraw due to injury and Turgarev rescheduled to face Omiel Brown at [[#Cage Warriors 198|Cage Warriors 198]].{{Cite web |date=2025-10-28 |title=Tugarev vs. Brown Title Fight Set For Manchester |url=https://cagewarriors.com/tugarev-vs-brown-interim-title-fight-set-for-manchester/ |access-date=2025-11-12 |website=Cage Warriors |language=en}}\n\nAs a results, a featherweight bout between Damon Wilson and Aiden Lee was scheduled to serve as the new headliner.{{Cite web |date=2025-11-11 |title=Coming Up on Cage Warriors: Manchester |url=https://cagewarriors.com/coming-up-on-cage-warriors-manchester/ |access-date=2025-11-12 |website=Cage Warriors |language=en}} However, the bout was shifted to the co-main event when the event promoted as a welterweight bout between Anthony Orozco and Evaldo dos Santos to serve as the main event.{{Cite web |date=2025-11-18 |title=CW 197: Unplugged \u2013 Official Card & Broadcast Times |url=https://cagewarriors.com/cw-197-unplugged-final-card-broadcast-times/ |access-date=2025-11-19 |website=Cage Warriors |language=en}} In turn, Santos pulled out due to not being medically cleared and the bout was cancelled. Therefore, the bout between Lee and Wilson was promoted to new headliner again.{{Cite tweet |author=Cage Warriors |user=CageWarriors |number=1991846976762097908 |title=Due to Evaldo Santos not being medically cleared to compete, his scheduled main event bout with Anthony Orozco has been cancelled.}}\n\n===Results===\n{{MMAevent}}\n{{MMAevent card|Main card (UFC Fight Pass)}}\n{{MMAevent Przybysz vs. Azevedo''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki on January 25, 2025, at the [[Radomskie Centrum Sportu|Radom Sports Center]] in [[Radom]], [[Poland]].\n\n===Background===\n\nOn December 16, 2024, the KSW organization announced the termination of cooperation with champion Jakub Wik\u0142acz and the termination of the contract with him by mutual consent of the parties. After the current champion Wik\u0142acz left KSW, Przybysz fought once again for the bantamweight championship belt on January 25, 2025, during XTB KSW 102 in Radom. His opponent was Brazilian Bruno Azevedo, ranked 2nd in the ranking.{{Cite web|date=2024-12-16|title=KSW Announces Jakub Wiklacz's Departure & Vacant Bantamweight Title Fight Arena]]\n|city={{flagicon|CZE}} [[Liberec]]\n|attendance=\n|previousevent=\n|followingevent=\n}}\n\n'''XTB KSW 103: Brichta vs. Charzewski''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event held by Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki on February 21, 2025, at the [[Home Credit Arena]] in [[Liberec]], Czech Republic.\n\n===Background===\n\nOn February 21, 2025, the KSW brand will return to the Czech Republic. The XTB KSW 103 will take place in Liberec, where the KSW organization has already appeared twice. Famous Czech names are scheduled to appear in the main fights of the evening: Leo Brichta, Dominik Humburger and [[Josef \u0160tummer]]. Brichta, who has previously fought in the lightweight category, is to make his debut in the featherweight category during the XTB KSW 103. This was celebration of the city's 100th anniversary.{{Cite web |last=Tkaczuk |first=Micha\u0142 |date=2026-04-15 |title=Og\u0142oszono termin, oraz miejsce gali XTB KSW 120. Sztuk Walki#XTB KSW 103: Brichta vs. Charzewski|KSW 103]] in February 2025.{{Cite web |last=Tkaczuk |first=Micha\u0142 |date=2026-05-31 |title=Organizacja KSW wraca do Liberca {{!}} MMAROCKS Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#XTB KSW 110: Grzebyk vs. Tulshaev|KSW 110]] in September 2025.{{Cite web |last=Celuth |first=Martyna |date=2026-07-18 |title=Mistrzowskie starcie Bartosi\u0144skiego z |language=pl-PL}}\n\nA [[Konfrontacja Sztuk Walki#Welterweight championship|KSW Welterweight Championship]] bout between current champion [[Adrian Bartosi\u0144ski]] and undefeated prospect Adam Masaev was originally scheduled to headline the event.{{Cite web |last=\u0141osak |first=Jacek |date=2026-07-18 |title=Bartosi\u0144ski vs Masaev walk\u0105 wieczoru gali XTB KSW 122 {{!}} MMAROCKS |language=pl-PL}}\n\nA bantamweight bout between Andrzej Karkula and Sebastian Decowski was scheduled at this event, but Decowski withdrew due to an injury and was replaced by Kamil Korzeniowski.{{Cite web |last=Nielubiak |first=Gregorz |date=2026-09-22 |title=Andrzej Karkula z nowym rywalem na gal\u0119 XTB KSW 122 |url=https://inthecage.pl/andrzej-karkula-z-nowym-rywalem-na-gale-xtb-ksw-122/ |access-date=2026-09-23 |website=InTheCage.pl |language=pl-PL}}\n\nA light heavyweight bout between [[Sergiusz Zaj\u0105c]] and Bartosz Szewczyk was scheduled at the event.{{Cite web |last=Zubkiewicz |first=Bart\u0142omiej |date=2026-08-20 |title=Starcie czo\u0142owych p\u00f3\u0142ci\u0119\u017ckich dodane do karty walk gali XTB KSW 122 {{!}} MMAROCKS |url=https://www.mmarocks.pl/bartosz-szewczyk/starcie-czolowych-polciezkich-dodane-do-karty-walk-gali-xtb-ksw-122 |access-date=2026-09-04 |website=MMA Rocks! Ian Dean\n| founded = {{start date and age|df=yes|2001||}}\n| founder = Dougie Truman\n| headquarters = [[London]], England\n| website = http://www.cagewarriors.com\n}}\n'''Cage Warriors''' ('''CW''') is an Irish-owned [[mixed martial arts]] (MMA) [[promoter (entertainment)|promotion company]] based in [[London]], England. The promotion was established in 2001 and staged its first [[Mixed Martial Arts|MMA]] event in London in July, 2002.\n\nMany MMA stars have made their names under the Cage Warriors banner, including [[Conor McGregor]], [[Michael Bisping]], [[Paddy Pimblett]], [[Gegard Mousasi]], [[Tom Aspinall]], [[Ant\u00f4nio Silva (fighter)|Ant\u00f4nio Silva]], [[Ian Machado Garry]], [[Martin Kampmann]], [[Dan Hardy]], [[Joseph Duffy (fighter)|Joe Duffy]], [[Cathal Pendred]], [[Neil Seery]], and [[Dennis Siver]].{{cite web|url=http://www.the42.ie/the-70-former-cage-warriors-fighters-who-ended-up-in-the-ufc-2701827-Apr2016/ |title=The 70 former Cage Warriors fighters who ended up in the UFC |website=The42.ie |date=8 April 2016 |access-date=14 April 2016}} CW are one of the few top promotions to take their events abroad, travelling throughout countries in [[Europe]], [[North America]] and the [[Middle East]].{{cite web |last=Bower |first=Mick |url=http://www.sabotagetimes.com/football-sport/mmas-arab-spring-how-cage-warriors-are-taking-over-the-middle-east/ |title=MMA's Arab Spring: How Cage Warriors Are Taking Over The Middle East |publisher=Sabotage Times |date=25 May 2012 |access-date=10 February 2014 |archive-date=29 August 2012 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120829011239/http://www.sabotagetimes.com/football-sport/mmas-arab-spring-how-cage-warriors-are-taking-over-the-middle-east/ |url-status=usurped }}\n\nThe promotion is watched globally via a host of television partners such as [[Viasat (Nordic television service)|Viasat]], and is one of the featured promotions on the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] (UFC)'s digital streaming service, [[UFC Fight Pass]]. It is currently being presented by UFC & BT Sport analyst [[Dan Hardy]], with commentators Josh Palmer and Brad Wharton.{{cite tweet|number=912644505672744960|user=CageWarriors|title=.@MMABrad48 and @JoshPalmerMMA...|date=26 September 2017}}\n\n==History==\n'''Cage Warriors Fighting Championship (CWFC)''' was founded by Dougie Truman in 2001; the first event, titled 'Armageddon', took place on 27 July 2002, and saw notable fighters such as Jean Silva, [[Rosi Sexton]], Matt Ewin and Paul Jenkins claim victories.{{cite web|url=http://www.sherdog.com/events/CWFC-1-Armaggeddon-1078 |title=CWFC 1 - Armageddon |publisher=Sherdog.com |date=27 July 2002 |access-date=10 February 2014}}\n\nIrishman Graham Boylan assumed control of Cage Warriors in 2010 and expanded the promotion's reach to mainland Europe and Asia, staging shows in England, Ireland, Russia, Ukraine, Jordan, United Arab Emirates, Lebanon and Bahrain.{{cite web|url=http://www.mmaweekly.com/cage-warriors-events-to-be-streamed-live-on-ufc-fight-pass |title=Cage Warriors Events to be Streamed Live on UFC Fight Pass |website=MMAWeekly.com |date=17 April 2016 |access-date=4 May 2016}} The Cage Warriors head office is located in [[London]].{{cite web |url=http://www.bloodyelbow.com/2015/2/11/8017991/cage-warriors-ceo-graham-boylan-steps-down-mma-news |title=Cage Warriors CEO resigns, promotion's future uncertain |publisher=Bloodyelbow.com |date=11 February 2015 |access-date=1 July 2015 |archive-date=4 March 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304055039/http://www.bloodyelbow.com/2015/2/11/8017991/cage-warriors-ceo-graham-boylan-steps-down-mma-news |url-status=dead }}{{cite web|url=http://www.mmafighting.com/2015/6/29/8862797/graham-boylan-acquires-cage-warriors-brand-eyes-potential-rebrand-and |title=Graham Boylan acquires Cage Warriors brand, eyes potential rebrand and two shows in 2015 |date=29 June 2015 |publisher=Mmafighting.com |access-date=1 July 2015}}\n\nFollowing Cage Warriors 74 in November 2014 the promotion went into hiatus, with Boylan announcing his resignation as CEO in February 2015.\n\nHowever, in June 2015, Boylan announced on ''[[The MMA Hour]]'' he had acquired the promotion and would be bringing it back to prominence again.{{Cite web|url=http://cagewarriors.com/former-cage-warriors-ceo-graham-boylan-acquires-the-cwfc-brand/|title=Former Cage Warriors CEO Graham Boylan acquires the CWFC brand - Cage Warriors|website=cagewarriors.com|language=en-GB|access-date=5 October 2017|archive-date=5 October 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171005201816/http://cagewarriors.com/former-cage-warriors-ceo-graham-boylan-acquires-the-cwfc-brand/|url-status=dead}}\n\nThe promotion has since secured a digital broadcasting deal with the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship|UFC]] to have its shows shown live across the world on [[UFC Fight Pass]],{{Cite news|url=http://cagewarriors.com/partners/broadcast-partners/|title=Broadcast Partners - Cage Warriors|work=Cage Warriors|access-date=5 October 2017|language=en-GB|archive-date=5 October 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171005151930/http://cagewarriors.com/partners/broadcast-partners/|url-status=dead}} and has also brokered television broadcast deals with major broadcasters across Europe and Asia.\n\nCage Warriors 114 marked the first time a mixed martial arts event in the [[United Kingdom]] was officially approved by the government.{{cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2020/09/cage-warriors-makes-history-with-first-government-recognized-mma-shows-in-u-k|title=Cage Warriors makes history with first government-recognized MMA shows in U.K.|author=Simon Head|date=10 September 2020|work=[[MMAjunkie.com]]}}\n\n==Broadcast deals==\nCage Warriors Events are watched globally via a host of television partners such as [[Viasat
